title: Apache ZooKeeper variables
description: Configuration variables for Apache ZooKeeper coordination and leader election quorum

ZOOKEEPER_VERSION.description: Specific version of Apache ZooKeeper to install.

ZOOKEEPER_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install Apache ZooKeeper ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT.description: TCP port on which ZooKeeper listens for client connections.

ZOOKEEPER_DATA_DIR.description: Filesystem directory path for ZooKeeper transaction logs and znode snapshots.

ZOOKEEPER_SERVERS.description: Comma-separated list of ensemble server quorum definitions (e.g. 'server.1=127.0.0.1:2888:3888').

ZOOKEEPER_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for zookeeper (ZOOKEEPER_HOME).
